mainEntity.name: How does AI SEO differ from standard SEO practices for legal websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO distinguishes itself from standard SEO by integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning into various aspects of optimization. Standard SEO relies on manual research and best practices, whereas AI SEO uses algorithms to analyze large datasets, predict trends, and automate adjustments. This allows for more precise targeting, faster identification of opportunities, and more dynamic adaptation to search engine algorithm changes, often leading to more efficient results.
